correctness.rationale: The mathematical statements hold. In every topology omega(A) is closed and omega(omega(A)) is contained in omega(A); the all-subsets identity and surjectivity then give transitivity by testing singleton targets. A loop makes its nonempty fibre A lie in omega(A), so omega(A) is a nonempty closed omega-perfect set. In (3) the quotient-cluster order rises on comparisons between clusters and only the integer coordinate rises on comparisons within a reflexive cluster. Each least open neighborhood meets a saturated target infinitely exactly when it sees a strictly higher target cluster or a target in its own reflexive cluster. With no loops each nonidentity comparison strictly raises the finite cluster, which precludes a perfect set. The componentwise action on the disjoint sum gives the stated exact logics by finite-frame countermodels and soundness on arbitrary valuations. A finite space has identically empty omega, which gives both the size obstruction for a nonempty relation and the validity of not-diamond-top, not a theorem of either logic. Inspected checker.py and VERIFICATION.md; finite tests are diagnostic only.
